faq.a: FlexPilot is an advanced multi-camera mirror dash cam designed to give you greater control over your driving view. Supporting up to four cameras with up to 2 × 4K and 2 × 1080P simultaneous recording, it lets you customize camera angles and viewing layouts to suit your needs. With features like a 1500-nit adaptive display, ADAS, BSD alerts, GPS, Wi-Fi 6 connectivity, and parking monitoring, FlexPilot helps you capture more details and stay aware of your surroundings on every journey.

faq.q: Product Overview | What makes FlexPilot different from traditional dash cams?
faq.a: Unlike traditional dash cams, FlexPilot supports up to four cameras, allowing you to customize camera positions and viewing layouts based on your driving needs. Whether you're off-roading, driving daily, or traveling in an RV, FlexPilot gives you more ways to see what's around you.

faq.q: Product Overview | Does FlexPilot support 4K recording? How many cameras can it support?
faq.a: Yes. Both the Front Cam and Flex Cam support 4K HDR recording. FlexPilot supports up to four cameras recording simultaneously, with a maximum configuration of 2 × 4K cameras and 2 × 1080P cameras.

faq.q: Camera Setup & Installation | What camera configurations are available?
faq.a: FlexPilot offers several camera options through different reward packages, including Front Cam, Flex Cam, Exterior Cam, Side Cam and Cabin Cam. Check the reward descriptions to find the setup that best fits your needs.

faq.q: Camera Setup & Installation | Can I customize my camera setup and viewing angles?
faq.a: Absolutely. You can customize camera positions and viewing layouts based on your vehicle and driving needs, helping you monitor the areas that matter most.

faq.q: Camera Setup & Installation | Is FlexPilot compatible with my vehicle?
faq.a: FlexPilot is compatible with most vehicles. It can be powered using either a hardwire kit or your vehicle's 12V power outlet. If you have any questions about installation or compatibility, feel free to contact our support team at service@wolfbox.com or +1 888 296 8399.

faq.q: Camera Setup & Installation | Is FlexPilot easy to install? Do I need professional installation?
faq.a: FlexPilot is designed for DIY installation, so professional installation isn't required for basic setup. WOLFBOX will provide official installation guides to walk you through the process. If you're unfamiliar with vehicle wiring or installing additional cameras, we recommend seeking help from a professional installer.

faq.q: Camera Setup & Installation | How can I mount FlexPilot on my vehicle?
faq.a: You can use an optional OEM bracket or the included straps to attach FlexPilot to your vehicle's original rearview mirror. Please note that the OEM bracket is sold separately.

faq.q: Recording & Features | What memory card does FlexPilot support?
faq.a:
FlexPilot supports microSD cards up to 1TB. Since it records high-resolution footage from multiple cameras simultaneously, we recommend a high-endurance card with at least 256GB capacity and a U3/V30 or higher speed rating.
You can also conveniently purchase a high-performance WOLFBOX memory card directly from our Kickstarter Add-ons for a smoother and more reliable recording experience.

faq.q: Recording & Features | Does FlexPilot support loop recording and parking monitoring?
faq.a: Yes. You can choose loop recording intervals of 1, 2, 3, 5, or 10 minutes. Please note that the 10-minute option is available only with SD cards of 256GB or higher capacity. Parking monitoring is supported when FlexPilot is connected to a separately purchased hardwire kit.

faq.q: Recording & Features | Are all cameras waterproof?
faq.a: The Flex Cam, Exterior Cam, and Side Cam are all IP67-rated for reliable performance in outdoor conditions. The Front Cam and Cabin Cam are designed for use in non-water-exposed environments. The Cabin Cam also features IR lighting to help capture clearer footage inside your vehicle in low-light conditions.

faq.q: VIP Deposit | What is the $10 VIP deposit, and what benefits does it unlock?
faq.a: The $10 deposit paid during the pre-launch period secures your access to our exclusive VIP Early Bird offer. VIP benefits include 35% off your selected reward, an additional 1-year warranty (30 months in total), and a $10 WOLFBOX gift card. The deposit itself is not a Kickstarter pledge or a purchase of the product.

faq.q: VIP Deposit | How do I claim my VIP Early Bird offer?
faq.a: Once the Kickstarter campaign launches, you'll receive an email with your exclusive VIP link. Simply use this link to visit our Kickstarter campaign and choose the VIP Early Bird reward that best suits your needs to enjoy the exclusive 35% discount.

faq.q: VIP Deposit | How will I receive my additional warranty and $10 gift card?
faq.a: After you receive your FlexPilot, the additional 1-year warranty will be automatically registered, extending your standard warranty from 18 to 30 months. Your $10 WOLFBOX gift card will also be sent to your email address.

faq.q: VIP Deposit | What is the difference between VIP Early Bird and regular Early Bird?
faq.a: Both offer the same 35% off Kickstarter price. However, VIP deposit holders are guaranteed access to the 35% off offer through their exclusive VIP link, while regular Early Bird rewards are available in limited quantities and may sell out. VIP deposit holders also receive an additional 1-year warranty (30 months in total) and a $10 WOLFBOX gift card.
